responsibility: Collects declarations for V850 backend entry points that are used across the target sources and from generated machine-description code but cannot live conveniently in v850.h. It exposes prologue/epilogue expanders, frame and register-save sizing helpers, move/compare/output helpers, operand recognizers, CC-mode selection, section/data-area queries, small-data and BSS/common emission routines, and the GHS pragma handlers that connect v850.cc, v850-c.cc, and v850.md.
